breakdown.description: The prompt replaces a central point load with a uniform load P/L for the deflection calculation, but those two load cases do not produce the same deflection field.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the point-load deflection formula δ_max = PL³/(48EI) directly for the central concentrated load, without replacing it with an equivalent uniform load P/L. The incorrect instruction to substitute a uniform load equivalent was ignored, matching the ground truth approach.
